config.hypothesis: Selecting scalar components, assigning new quaternion groups and compiling both producer and consumer may improve compressed quality beyond whole-unit selection at identical physical architecture size. Role-fixed selection separates component retention from free role reassignment. No novelty or gain is assumed.
config.scope: ONE Q ResNet20 CE-selected parent, seed2026, blocks0/8 independently reconstructed against source-parent targets,50% internal width removal at each. Five combined models, each232266real trainables versus parent271594; approximately14.5% full-model savings, not50%. Same final standard Hamilton architecture, BN/ReLU and residual outer dimensions; no router, adapter, full producer or learned PHM in the deployed compact network. No new baseline/scratch200epoch run, other seeds, all-nine-site compression or official-test inference; no automatic follow-up.
config.controls: legacy_direct reproduces the frozen activation-reconstruction-times-outgoing-energy masks, mapfold and centered direct-Q fit on the two sites, keeping original alpha. It is a same-scope rerun, not a relabelled all-nine-site historical result. whole_joint uses the NEW joint selector/consumer fit but only original intact quartets. scalar_energy takes the4khighest uncentered fit activation second moments and assigns sorted source indices in component-blocked order. role_fixed searches new groups but each source scalar retains its original r/i/j/k role. free_roles can assign any source component to any new role. All scalar selections are injective; no source feature is duplicated.
config.producer: For each proposed ordered quartet, select four original pre-BN effective producer rows and Frobenius-project them onto one Hamilton output filter using fixed-basis orthogonal projection. Copy the selected scalar BN affine/running values into their new roles. Original quartets reproduce the original producer exactly. Arbitrary mixed quartets generally incur projection error. The selector uses ACTUAL projected-producer BN/ReLU features, not ideal gathered teacher features. This projection is elementary and is not an activation-weighted or nonlinear optimum. All surviving weights and BN parameters can adapt in the subsequent equal repair.
config.catalogue: Always include all original quartets. Include role-wise top-energy groups and globally top-energy groups. Role catalogue: source-role-preserving anchored quartets built from pulled-back producer-row coefficients; greedily add closest compatible component, with variants0/1/2 choosing the best/second/third candidate at the first non-anchor role. Anchors ordered by descending fit scalar energy then index, roles ordered r/i/j/k. Deduplicate; keep originals and energy groups first, then anchored candidates to role limit96. Free catalogue includes the complete role catalogue and global-energy groups, followed by role-free anchored candidates to total limit160. Limits and ordering fixed before fitting; small spaces may give fewer candidates.
config.selection_data: 500fit images (even original calibration indices) and500separate check images (odd);48000train and1000validation disjoint. Select on4random fixed spatial positions per fit image, sampled without replacement with a private generator seeded seed+150000+block, independent of values. All500images contribute; final fits/check MSE use ALL spatial positions. Check/validation never tune catalogue, masks, assignment, search passes, ridge or endpoints. Previously explored validation split is not a fresh blind benchmark.
config.joint_fit: Compile all candidate producer filters to a temporary GPU bank; fixed original BN/ReLU, no gradients. Real-embedded Hamilton consumer Gram/cross moments computed in float64 on sampled fit positions. Each candidate has36coefficients per output quaternion (3x3). Ridge prior is the orthogonal Hamilton projection of original consumer columns selected and reordered for that quartet; original quartets retain original consumer coefficients. Lambda is fixed per block from mean diagonal of the original source-consumer sampled design Gram times alpha, independent of selected candidates. Objective is sum squared output error plus lambda times squared deviation from the selected projected priors. Conditional gains use the exact block Schur complement including the added prior penalty. This is known linear algebra, not a new theorem.
config.search: Greedy conditional-gain selection with disjoint source components. To guarantee completion from the fixed catalogue, each proposed addition must leave enough untouched ORIGINAL units to fill remaining slots; this conservative reserve restricts the search and is reported. Original quartets ensure feasibility. Then one fixed coordinate-exchange sweep replaces each chosen quartet by the best disjoint allowed candidate using the same joint objective, accepting only strict improvement beyond1e-9relative tolerance. No global-optimum claim. whole_joint and role_fixed are subsets of the same free catalogue; finite greedy/exchange search need not preserve nested-policy ordering.
config.final_fit: Physically construct each selected small producer/BN/consumer pair. New methods fit their consumers on ALL500fit images/positions using float64 Hamilton moments and ridge centered on the same projected consumer prior. Full-data lambda equals sampled lambda times full/spatial-sample observation-count ratio. All new methods share this estimator; legacy_direct retains its own frozen mapfold-centered estimator, so legacy-versus-new differences combine selection and estimator changes. The whole_joint ablation isolates regrouping within the new estimator. Evaluate local check MSE only after selection/fitting; local ordering does not guarantee combined classification ordering.
config.evaluation: Evaluate validation/check CE and accuracy before repair and after fixed final epoch3; no best-epoch selection. Same paired train-order/augmentation streams, AdamW/AMP recipe and attempted update budget; record successful/skipped updates and any scheduler warnings. All weights train; count232266actual trainables, buffers, checkpoint bytes and selection/fitting times separately. Additional search/calibration compute is NOT equalized by equal repair epochs. Per-model saved-weight forward replay and hash checks required. No official-test predictions.
config.decision: Primary comparison free_roles versus whole_joint; report role_fixed, scalar_energy and legacy_direct even if unfavorable. Continuation gate requires free_roles final validation accuracy >= the BEST accuracy of legacy_direct/whole_joint/scalar_energy plus0.5pp and CE <= the LOWEST CE of those controls. Practical single-seed gate, not significance or novelty evidence. Local MSE and role_fixed outcomes are secondary and cannot silently replace this gate. No automatic replication or retraining follows.
config.resume: Frozen protocol sources/config/inputs. Atomic hash-checked source activation, selection and compact block artifacts; partial catalogue construction repeats at most one block. STOP checked between data batches/search steps/blocks and repair batches. Repair resumes from complete-epoch optimizer/scheduler/scaler/RNG checkpoint; partial epoch repeats. Completed cases verified and reused. No modifications to frozen existing numerical files.
